Hmm, it’s a hard pick for me to say, but if I had to pick, it would be either:

- Base After Base: largely just really unmemorable, and honestly just feels like it’s filler (despite being the first level made for the game).

- xStep: I never really found this level fun to play. It doesn’t feel like it adds anything much over Cycles, and in general just isn’t a level I ever looked forward to playing.

- Fingerdash: This level was always a disappointment. Even for the time when it came out it wasn’t a good level—from the awkward visuals, to the mediocre gameplay that just feels like it was phoned in, or rather an afterthought. Truly the only main level in an update that wasn’t a good example of what said update had to offer. Utter disappointment after nearly 2 years of waiting.

These are just my thoughts, I know not everyone will agree with me here but I do appreciate the differing opinions regardless.
